visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and bangs is dancing on a city street at night. She is wearing a white off-the-shoulder fuzzy sweater, black shorts, and black knee-high boots. The background features tall office buildings with glowing windows and trees with yellow autumn leaves scattered on the pavement. The lighting is dominated by artificial streetlights and building lights. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor bedroom where the same woman is sitting on a white bed, leaning against white curtains. She holds a light purple smartphone and smiles at the camera while gesturing with her hands. The lighting is bright and warm. (3) A screen recording or close-up of the smartphone displays a digital interface. The woman uses a stylus or her finger to interact with an AI tool, which generates an image of her holding flowers in a restaurant. (4) An AI-generated video appears, showing the woman in a long black halter-neck dress walking down a red carpet. Dozens of photographers are visible on either side, their camera flashes creating bright bursts of light. (5) Back in the bedroom, the woman continues to talk to the camera, holding the phone. She looks expressive and energetic. (6) A top-down shot shows three outfits laid out on the white bed: a black long-sleeve top, a brown skirt, a white sweater, and blue jeans. A digital UI box highlights the white sweater. (7) A still photograph shows the woman posing in a grand hotel lobby with a spiral staircase, wearing the white sweater, jeans, and a beige handbag. (8) Returning to the bedroom, the woman points toward the viewer while talking, ending with a cheerful expression. (9) The screen fades to black with a centered white brand logo.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A night-time city street with skyscrapers and autumn leaves; a bright indoor bedroom with white curtains; an AI-generated red carpet event with paparazzi; a luxurious hotel lobby with a spiral staircase.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, energetic electronic pop music begins. A cheerful female voice greets the audience and describes dancing alone in Korea. (2) A subtle digital 'ding' sound triggers as the narrator mentions AI image generation. The music maintains a constant high-tempo beat. (3) The acoustic texture shifts slightly as simulated camera shutter clicks and paparazzi-style sound effects are layered over the music during the red carpet segment. (4) A second female voice, identified as an AI assistant, speaks with a calm, flat, but clear professional tone, recommending an outfit. The BGM ducks slightly to prioritize the AI voice. (5) The primary narrator returns with high vocal arousal and pitch, concluding the video by inviting user engagement. The music swells briefly before a quick fade out at the brand logo.
